qualification:
Actual AccountInfo borrow operations across every concrete borrow counter.
The isolated harness validates the pinned compiler's RefCell counter location
before injecting forgotten-guard states. It does not alter production SDK code.
A layout/toolchain change requires a fresh check, not a portable layout claim.
domain: Every isize borrow-counter value, including MAX, MAX-1 and MIN; real SDK AccountInfo/Rc/RefCell, all bytes and lengths0..1768. Counter injection changes only an isolated test allocation, validated by public SDK borrow transitions. This checks the operational leaf; it is not a theorem of arbitrary trace reachability or complete adapter correspondence.
